summary: The author recommends including Delta mode in the initial specification to improve compression for sorted or slowly changing columns and proposes renaming the scheme to FastLanes. The proposal is to make the inline data the authoritative source while treating locator fields as provenance only, thereby resolving the ambiguity and maintaining backward compatibility. Participants suggest updating the guide to remove the fixed recommendation and provide guidance on selecting page sizes based on workload and storage type. It aims to standardize how engines handle serialized messages, enabling archiving of event streams while preserving the original bytes.
